title: invocation-cohort-correlation-dashboard-and-causal-span-join
author: Sofia Martinez
description: SUMMARY: This PR instruments cohorted invocation latency and token-variance metrics, adds a correlation dashboard to surface cohort-level regressions, and implements a causal span->log join helper to make long-tail investigations easier. MOTIVATION: We keep seeing noisy p99 regressions driven by a small set of invocation archetypes (long sequences with cold KV cache or backfilled tool calls). Current per-route aggregates hide these cohorts and make alerting noisy. This change creates explicit cohorts and correlation surfaces so SREs and oncall can tune alerts and triage regressions with fewer false positives. WHAT'S INCLUDED: 1) Metrics: invocation_latency_ms_cohort{cohort,model,route,tenant}, invocation_token_variance_cohort{cohort,model,route}, kv_cache_hit_ratio_cohort{cohort}, invocation_cohort_sample_count. Cohort keys: model+route+sequence_length_bucket+kv_cache_hint+tool_invocation_flag. 2) Collector: new invocation_cohort_collector service that attaches cohort tags at ingest time and exposes aggregation-friendly labels for rollups. 3) Tracing: causal_span_joiner that links span IDs with sampled log anchors and provides a compact mapping for UI log fetches; supports late-arrival span hydration. 4) Dashboard: observability/dashboards/invocation-cohort-correlation.jsonnet containing cohort heatmaps (p50/p95/p99), token-variance violin panels, KV-cache correlation matrix, and a cohort-level traceback panel that surfaces representative traces. 5) Alerts: new alert rule invocation_cohort_p99_surge with dampening and a per-cohort suppression window to avoid alert storms from noisy tenants; added playbook notes in docs/observability/invocation-cohorting.md. 6) Backwards compatibility: metric names are additive; collector falls back to legacy metric labels if cohort tagging fails. CHECKLIST: - [x] Collector implementation and unit tests - [x] Dashboard panels and templating - [x] Alert rule and playbook - [x] Integration tests for span->log join - [x] Docs update and migration notes COMPATIBILITY & RISK: Low-risk additive metrics. The collector adds labels which increase cardinality for a controlled set of cohorts; cohort cardinality is bounded by sequence_length buckets to limit explosion. The causal join introduces a short-lived in-memory cache; instrumentation includes adaptive eviction to avoid memory spikes. OBSERVABILITY: Added metrics + traces for rollout 100% behind a feature flag telemetry.cohort_mode. Plan: enable in staging for 72h and monitor ingestion cost and SLOs before broad rollout.

review_comments: Ethan Wu: Nice approach on cohort keying, can we limit sequence_length buckets to powers-of-two to reduce cardinality?
Sofia Martinez: Good call, switched to powers-of-two buckets and added unit tests to assert bucket boundaries.
Priya Nair: The alert dampening looks sensible but add a note in the playbook about when to escalate to chief oncall; also add a small synthetic test to validate suppressed flapping.
Sofia Martinez: Added escalation steps and a synthetic replay harness to the integration tests.
Luca Moretti: One nit: prefer explicit metric units in names (ms) for latency metrics to avoid confusion across teams.
Sofia Martinez: Renamed metrics to include _ms suffix where appropriate and updated dashboard panels.
release_notes: Add cohorted invocation latency and token-variance metrics, new correlation dashboard, and cohort-aware alerting to reduce noisy p99 alerts. Rollout gated behind telemetry.cohort_mode feature flag.
